ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is triangle RST, and the angle label at vertex R is (4y - 10)°; on the right side is triangle XYZ, and the angle label at vertex X is (3y + 5)°. The problem gives △RST ≅ △XYZ, so they correspond in alphabetical order: R ↔ X, S ↔ Y, T ↔ Z. Reasoning: Corresponding angles are equal, so ∠R = ∠X, obtaining 4y - 10 = 3y + 5. Subtract 3y from both sides to get y - 10 = 5, then add 10 to both sides to get y = 15.
